verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Loops offers distinct transactional email sending (its own API/backend calls) separate from marketing/lifecycle campaigns, and migration guides note transactional vs marketing distinctions, but there is no explicit documentation of separate suppression-list logic or dedicated sending reputation ensuring transactional mail still reaches unsubscribed contacts. Missing for 10: explicit suppression-rule separation, reputation isolation, and confirmation that unsubscribe status doesn't block transactional sends.
